ControlBlockSize is 3; edge blocks may be partial
Runtime applies pollution to the entire block; legacy test conflicts
Owned and unpolluted cell controls its block
Standard cell must be owned, unpolluted, and empty
Cost and per-unit cooldown gate deployment
Initial values clamp; non-positive gain is ignored
Fixed and transmitter timers produce independently
Non-positive spend is a successful no-op
Deploy list maximum is 12
First requirement 7; next same-stage requirement 14

No controlled unpolluted block means defeat
No valid spawn can mean defeat when building objective is disabled
Zero enemy buildings means victory when enabled
RequiredAssaultScore exists but does not currently decide victory
Allies advance forward; enemies advance backward; adjacent-block arrival selects the battle block and reserved faction rows; survivors resume movement

PerWave caps unique spawn columns and Types are selected by integer weights using a seeded RNG

Application controls wave lifecycle and turns spawn requests into combat actors without putting QFramework in Domain

Enemy-building death updates building count and spawn points before outcome evaluation
Every enemy death awards its non-negative reward once; required score does not directly override building victory
